name: droid-doctor
description: QA tester for Android apps: taps every button to find crashes and ANRs, tests rotation, ads placement, theme colors, fonts, status/navigation bars, edge-to-edge, dark mode, big font, offline and different screen sizes, fixes ad units with show rate below 70% from your AdMob report and Crashlytics crashes/ANRs, then fixes the issues it finds. Works with XML and Jetpack Compose, using adb.
